body:
_Make sure untrusted HTML from WYSIWYG editors or similar are properly sanitized with an HTML sanitizer and handle it appropriately according to the input validation task and encoding task._

Point of WYSIWYG is to render marked-up output.  Encoding may be viewed as incorrect. 

Suggest to simplify: 
Make sure that all untrusted HTML input from WYSIWYG editors or similar is properly sanitized with an HTML sanitizer library.
